---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or a change in approach
labels: enhancement
---

**What's the gap?** (what can't you do today, or what's harder than it
should be)

**Proposed approach**

**Trade-offs you've already considered** (why this approach over
alternatives — this project favors a documented trade-off over silently
picking one option)

**Does this affect the modularity contract?** (i.e. does it introduce any
hardcoded path/host/user, or stay configurable via `.env`/`inventory.ini`)
